# Psalm 13 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For-the-choirmaster. A-psalm of-David.

**2** How-long, YHWH? Will-You-forget-me forever? How-long will-You-hide Your-face from-me?

**3** How-long shall-I-set counsels in-my-soul, sorrow in-my-heart by-day? How-long shall-my-enemy be-exalted over-me?

**4** Look! Answer-me, YHWH my-God! Give-light [to] my-eyes, lest I-sleep the-death,

**5** lest my-enemy say, 'I-have-prevailed against-him,' [and] my-adversaries rejoice when I-am-shaken.

**6** But-I in-Your-steadfast-love have-trusted; my-heart rejoices in-Your-salvation. I-will-sing to-YHWH, for He-has-dealt-bountifully with-me.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **13:2-3**: Four 'how long' questions — the most concentrated expression of lament in the Psalter. The repetition is not redundancy but escalation.

— EMET
